motions.name: Dance Step Left
motions.observation: A clear step to the left from the dance stance, with a hand accent.
motions.interpretation: The weight rolls left, the left foot slides out a short step and plants on the half beat, the shoulders lean toward it, then the foot draws back into the stance by the end of the six-tenths-of-a-second clip.

motions.name: Dance Step Up
motions.observation: A forward hop-step with the hands lifting in front, from the dance stance.
motions.interpretation: Both feet hop a hand-span forward, the hands lift in front of the chest and the shoulders lean in, then everything returns to the dance stance in six-tenths of a second.

motions.name: Dance Step Down
motions.observation: A dip back from the dance stance: the knees bend, the weight sits back and the hands sweep low.
motions.interpretation: The hips sink and slide back, the chest leans away and both feet step back a short way while the hands sweep down and out, then the stance recovers in six-tenths of a second.

motions.name: Dance Step Right
motions.observation: A clear step to the right from the dance stance, with a hand accent.
motions.interpretation: The weight rolls right, the right foot slides out a short step and plants on the half beat, the shoulders lean toward it, then the foot draws back into the stance by the end of the six-tenths-of-a-second clip.

motions.name: Dance Dip
motions.observation: A low, dramatic dip and a sweeping rise.
motions.interpretation: The hips sink about twenty centimetres with the chest folding forward and the arms spread low, the pose holds a moment, then the body rises through a long upward arm sweep with a slight lean back before settling in the dance stance.

motions.name: Dance Spin
motions.observation: A full turn on one foot with both arms held out.
motions.interpretation: The performer shifts onto the left foot, throws both arms out to the sides and turns a full revolution with the right knee drawn up, then lowers the arms and steps back into the dance stance.

motions.name: Strings Low
motions.observation: A low string accent with the free playing hand near the upper soundboard or lower harp strings.
motions.interpretation: The free left hand plays an accent across the upper soundboard or lower harp strings while the engine carry layer keeps the right hand on the instrument. The body emphasizes the note, then returns to the shared playing hold.

motions.name: Strings Mid
motions.observation: A mid string accent with the free playing hand near the upper soundboard or lower harp strings.
motions.interpretation: The free left hand plays an accent across the upper soundboard or lower harp strings while the engine carry layer keeps the right hand on the instrument. The body emphasizes the note, then returns to the shared playing hold.

motions.name: Strings High
motions.observation: A high string accent with the free playing hand near the upper soundboard or lower harp strings.
motions.interpretation: The free left hand plays an accent across the upper soundboard or lower harp strings while the engine carry layer keeps the right hand on the instrument. The body emphasizes the note, then returns to the shared playing hold.

motions.name: Strings Flourish
motions.observation: A flourish string accent with the free playing hand near the upper soundboard or lower harp strings.
motions.interpretation: The body opens back and the free left hand sweeps across the strings, then settles into the shared playing hold. The right hand keeps the native carry grip.

motions.name: Horn Low
motions.observation: The chest sinks and the bell dips into a low note. Starts and ends at the held-to-the-mouth hold.
motions.interpretation: The chest sinks forward, the knees ease down, the bell dips and the left hand slides down the horn for a low note, then everything returns to the playing hold in half a second. The mouthpiece stays at the lips.

motions.name: Horn Mid
motions.observation: A neutral accent: a small sway into a note held level. Starts and ends at the held-to-the-mouth hold.
motions.interpretation: A neutral accent: a small sway of the shoulders as the bell swings slightly to the side and the left hand shifts a touch up the horn, then back to the playing hold in half a second. The mouthpiece stays at the lips.

motions.name: Horn High
motions.observation: The bell lifts high into a bright note with the chest opening. Starts and ends at the held-to-the-mouth hold.
motions.interpretation: The chest opens back, the knees straighten, the bell lifts and the left hand slides up the horn for a bright note, then everything returns to the playing hold in half a second. The mouthpiece stays at the lips.

motions.name: Horn Flourish
motions.observation: The horn swings up toward the ceiling for a long, ringing note.
motions.interpretation: The bell sweeps up and out while the chest opens back, the mouthpiece stays at the lips and the note holds at the top, then the horn lowers to the playing hold.

motions.name: Performance Bow
motions.observation: A courteous finale bow with one hand across the chest.
motions.interpretation: The performer gathers a hand to the chest, sweeps the other arm out and folds forward from the waist, holds the bow for a beat, then rises and releases to the dance stance.
